outcome: Use a Home Assistant forecast to show wind strength and add official regional warnings.

views.title: Clock & weather
views.condition: Provide the weather entity to Ramka, or with Ramka 0.17.0 or later name it in the home's shared inputs. Current weather appears with now playing; the configured climate page also includes a four-day forecast. With Weather 0.3.0 and Ramka 0.23.0 or later, the clock shows wind strength from breezy upwards and the controls offer a warnings list when strong wind or an official warning is active. The ambient warning banner is off by default and can be enabled in General settings.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Set up the Met.no integration with the location you choose in Home Assistant.
Verify the weather entity and forecast, then add or update the DomoSenso Weather component. Wind strength uses the weather entity's wind speed.
For optional gusts, set gusts: open_meteo. For official warnings, provide the MeteoAlarm country and warning region in warnings. Follow the upgrade notes for the data sent and supported inputs.
Update Weather before Ramka. Ramka adds wind details and the warning controls when the corresponding Home Assistant entities are available.
